notes: The Olympus Rebalance: 36 cards changed, the biggest balance pass yet. Athena, Poseidon, The Hydra, Chariot, and Spartan Warlord were the real problems and got trimmed; eighteen cards nobody played (Hermes, Fire Wisp, Watchtower, Wrath of Olympus, and more) got real buffs. Every number was measured before and after -- see the patch notes in-game. Titans are now COMING SOON: greyed out in your collection and not deckable yet, until their own update lands.
